# Objective-C runtime snapshot, format 3
architecture arm64
build-configuration Development
build-variant ASan
class RuntimeSnapshotPortAtomicObjCFixture
  language objc
  superclass NSObject
  image ModernTests
  ivar-arc-flag set
  strong-ivar-layout 0100
  weak-ivar-layout
  ivar _atomicCount types=q ownership=scalar layout=
  ivar _atomicObject types=@"NSObject" ownership=strong layout=s
  ivar _atomicRect types={CGRect="origin"{CGPoint="x"d"y"d}"size"{CGSize="width"d"height"d}} ownership=struct-or-cxx-object layout=
  instance-method -.cxx_destruct types=v16@0:8
  instance-method -atomicCount types=q16@0:8
  instance-method -atomicObject types=@16@0:8
  instance-method -atomicRect types={CGRect={CGPoint=dd}{CGSize=dd}}16@0:8
  instance-method -setAtomicCount: types=v24@0:8q16
  instance-method -setAtomicObject: types=v24@0:8@16
  instance-method -setAtomicRect: types=v48@0:8{CGRect={CGPoint=dd}{CGSize=dd}}16
  instance-property atomicCount type=q ownership=assign atomic ivar=_atomicCount raw=Tq,V_atomicCount
  instance-property atomicObject type=@"NSObject" ownership=strong atomic ivar=_atomicObject raw=T@"NSObject",&,V_atomicObject
  instance-property atomicRect type={CGRect={CGPoint=dd}{CGSize=dd}} ownership=assign atomic ivar=_atomicRect raw=T{CGRect={CGPoint=dd}{CGSize=dd}},V_atomicRect
end class RuntimeSnapshotPortAtomicObjCFixture
